pages.title: SHVYA Sales overview
pages.summary: Create and manage CRM-linked quotations, agreements and invoices.
pages.body:
## What SHVYA Sales includes
SHVYA Sales is the document workspace at [Dashboard → Sales](/dashboard/sales/). It supports quotations, agreements and invoices, reusable templates, PDF generation, selected delivery channels and post-sale payment lifecycle actions.

## Before creating a document
1. Confirm the organization and relevant CRM lead.
2. Set up your company identity, sender information and any available document settings.
3. Check tax, currency, payment instructions, terms and line items using your own approved figures.
4. Choose a suitable organization-owned template.

## Typical sales journey
1. Prepare a quotation linked to a lead.
2. Revise or finalize an agreement when terms are accepted.
3. Issue an invoice with correct totals and due dates.
4. Deliver the document through an eligible connected email or WhatsApp channel.
5. Review payment, credit and refund history through the supported Sales actions.

## Important boundaries
A saved draft, generated PDF, queued send and actual recipient delivery are separate states. The CRM lead remains organization-scoped and does not automatically gain permission to receive a WhatsApp free-form message outside the Meta service window.

[Documents](/docs/sales-calendar/sales-documents/) · [Payments](/docs/sales-calendar/invoices-payments/).

pages.title: Quotations, agreements and PDF delivery
pages.summary: Create templates, edit sales documents and verify what the customer received.
pages.body:
## Create a sales document
1. Open [SHVYA Sales](/dashboard/sales/), then **Documents**.
2. Create a **Quotation**, **Agreement** or **Invoice** according to the permitted document type.
3. Choose the CRM lead and approved template.
4. Enter line items, prices, tax details, terms and any attachments.
5. Preview the server-generated PDF and validate totals before sending.
6. Send using the authorized email or WhatsApp option and inspect its delivery record.

## Templates and revisions
Manage reusable templates from Sales → Templates. Agreement revisions and document editing maintain a history of the sales record. Editing a rendered template should be verified in the PDF preview: the email/chat copy is not a substitute for correct document formatting.

## Attachment safety
Only attach intended customer-facing files. Download access and document ownership remain organization-scoped. Avoid exposing provider tokens, private storage paths or unrelated lead documents.

## Common issues
- **PDF looks wrong:** check template variables, escaping, amount formatting and current document revision.
- **Template save fails:** verify required fields and any unsupported placeholder.
- **Email send fails:** verify connected mailbox and sender rights.
- **WhatsApp send fails:** check selected pipeline-bound sender, template/window, provider account and receipt.

[Sales troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/sales-errors/) · [Connected Email](/docs/connect-hub/email/).

pages.title: Invoices, payments and refunds
pages.summary: Handle due amounts, checkout links, credit notes and recurring invoices.
pages.body:
## Payment lifecycle
SHVYA Sales stores organization-scoped invoice payment details and supports actions such as manual payment records, eligible gateway payment links, refunds, credit notes and recurring invoice configuration. Available gateway actions depend on actual provider setup and plan.

## Record a manual payment
1. Open the correct invoice from Sales → Documents.
2. Review the outstanding balance and payment reference.
3. Use the supported **Record payment** action.
4. Enter the actual amount, date and payment method/reference.
5. Confirm the invoice ledger reflects the intended state.

## Gateway payments
Before sharing a checkout/payment link, verify its gateway configuration and association with the right invoice. Payment-link creation is not proof of successful payment. Inspect an authorized provider completion record before marking an external charge as paid.

## Credit and refund actions
Use the built-in refund or credit note action only for the correct original payment/invoice. Review partial amounts carefully. Do not issue a second refund while the provider's previous attempt is uncertain.

## Recurring invoices and schedules
Configure only approved repeating cycles and keep the customer's terms, billing start/stop date and time zone consistent. An asynchronously scheduled invoice or delivery should be checked after execution.

## Troubleshooting
Confirm the invoice ID, status, balance, payment record, gateway result, retry state and related CRM lead. Escalate an ambiguous financial outcome rather than duplicating a charge.

[Sales overview](/docs/sales-calendar/sales-overview/) · [Payment provider](/docs/connect-hub/razorpay/).

pages.title: SHVYA Calendar overview
pages.summary: Publish booking pages and manage appointments in one workspace.
pages.body:
## Two areas
- **Booking:** configure booking pages, meeting type, hosts, availability, reminders and published links at [SHVYA Calendar](/dashboard/shvya-calendar/).
- **Calendar:** view day, week and month appointments at [Calendar workspace](/dashboard/shvya-calendar/calendar/).

## Create a booking page
1. Open the Calendar booking area with organization-admin permission.
2. Select the destination pipeline/stage for new bookings.
3. Configure duration, time zone, notice, working hours, buffers, blocks and capacity.
4. Choose the meeting mode: phone, physical/custom location or supported Google Meet.
5. Configure relevant form fields and follow-up/reminder sequences.
6. Preview, publish and share the exact public booking URL.

## What happens on booking
A visitor submits a valid form and selects an available slot. SHVYA rechecks availability on the server before committing a booking, links or creates the CRM lead and updates the protected **Booked at** field. Slot submission does not automatically prove a Google event/link exists; provider synchronization is separate.

## Manage appointments
Open Calendar day/week/month views, filter by pipeline and select an appointment to inspect details. Authorized actions can reschedule, cancel or adjust lead routing, subject to capacity, tenant and terminal-status checks.

## If no slots appear
Check the published state, page time zone, active host, working hours, date notice, blockouts, buffer duration and calendar conflicts. Verify that your test date is truly inside the configured booking window.

[Google Calendar](/docs/sales-calendar/google-calendar/) · [Booking errors](/docs/sales-calendar/bookings-troubleshooting/).

pages.title: Google Calendar and Meet
pages.summary: Connect an organization's calendar or explicitly opt in to supported SHVYA-managed hosting.
pages.body:
## Google organizer options
For a Google Meet booking, SHVYA prefers an authorized Google account connected by the organization's host. An optional SHVYA-managed organizer fallback requires explicit organization consent and the platform's valid Google setup. A missing account without opted-in fallback does not create a fake meeting URL.

## Connect
1. Open SHVYA Calendar and choose the relevant booking page.
2. Select **Google settings** and review the organization's organizer preference.
3. For organization-owned events, have the intended host authorize their own Google account.
4. For eligible SHVYA-managed fallback, an organization admin may opt in if the service is platform-enabled.
5. Save, create a controlled test booking and confirm the meeting URL on the booking details.

## Reschedules and external edits
SHVYA retains the booking as the record of the appointment. Existing Google events keep their original organizer and event identity. Provider synchronization can update an accepted reschedule or detect supported external changes.

## If Meet link is missing
Inspect the booking's Google synchronization status and organizer preference. Check consent, host connection, account permission and provider errors. Do not manually invent a Meet URL or switch to another organization's account.

## Provider troubleshooting
Google OAuth and Calendar API permission errors require authorized administrator/operator action. The exact production callback is provided by the SHVYA deployment diagnostics; do not guess or put tokens in support tickets.

[Calendar](/docs/sales-calendar/calendar/) · [Booking troubleshooting](/docs/sales-calendar/bookings-troubleshooting/).

pages.title: Booking and reminder troubleshooting
pages.summary: Fix unavailable slots, confirmation problems and missing calendar reminders.
pages.body:
## Booking page not opening
Check whether the page is published and that the shared URL is the current public page, not an internal editor link. Try the published link in a private browser session. If it returns a server error, capture the URL path without secret tokens and the response time.

## Slot unavailable or confirmation fails
- Confirm the organization's time zone, the visitor's selected time and whether the slot remains available.
- Check working hours, calendar blocks, lead time, duration, capacity and buffer intervals.
- Verify the destination CRM pipeline/stage is valid and active.
- A simultaneous booking may have occupied the slot; retry with a newly fetched available time.

## Booked at not updating
Inspect the persisted booking and the linked lead, not just the calendar grid. **Booked at** is managed by the booking service. Multiple active bookings may require selecting the exact appointment rather than editing the attribute directly.

## Google Meet not ready
A SHVYA booking can exist while Google synchronization is pending, disconnected or failed. Check the saved organizer preference, Google status and page meeting type. Never send an invented link to the customer.

## Reminders not arriving
Review the reminder schedule and recipient details; check if the booking was cancelled or rescheduled. Confirm the selected WhatsApp sender, approved template/window, email connection or call-reminder rules and relevant worker health.

## Escalate with evidence
Provide the booking/page ID, intended date/time/timezone, selected slot, result shown, linked lead and a redacted screenshot. Do not include private cancellation/reschedule links.

[Help & Support](/docs/operations/support-tickets/) · [Google Calendar](/docs/sales-calendar/google-calendar/).
